newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Showpla secures US$22 mln loan facilities.
newsitem.headline: Showpla secures US$22 mln loan facilities.

text.p: Showpla Asia Ltd (SAL), a maker of injection moulded plastic components for consumer electronic industries, said on Tuesday it had secured two loan facilities for expansion into regional markets.
The company said in a statement the first loan facility would provide SAL with Singapore $10 million (US$7.09 million) in working capital and to refinance existing bank borrowings.

The second facility would provide US$15 million to finance investments in subsidiaries and associates and to provide additional working capital. It said the loans were obtained from DBS Bank, the arranger and agent bank.
